newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on stronger yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on stronger yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, pressured by sporadic selling in reaction to the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.1 yen to 3.4 yen per kg lower. Most-active benchmark October was off 2.1 yen at 138.3 yen.
Activity was lacklustre amid a lack of fresh incentives.

"Sporadic selling emerged from the outset as the yen's rebound dampened market sentiment," an analyst at a commodity broker said. "Rubber futures prices extended their early losses amid a lack of buying interest," he said.
